about: The datapoints to check by hand before the sets are trusted and grown: a stratified sample chosen by seed, 20 of the SQL set spread over its kinds and 10 of the chart set spread over its shapes. Rewrite it with `uv run finquery-bench sample --seed N`.

datapoints.question: What was my total income in 2025?
datapoints.why: Income is every positive amount, which is twelve salaries plus one Amazon refund. A model that reads income as the Income category gets nothing, because no booking carries it.
datapoints.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount_cents > 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

datapoints.question: How much did I spend at the supermarket in October?
datapoints.why: Supermarket is a subcategory of Groceries, and the bakery and the drugstore are its siblings: answering with the whole category adds 38,70 EUR nobody asked about.
datapoints.sql: SELECT ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount_cents < 0 AND subcategory = 'Supermarket' AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-10-31'

datapoints.question: Break my dining spending down by subcategory.
datapoints.why: The one question where the subcategory column is what is asked for. Grouping by category returns one row and answers nothing.
datapoints.sql: SELECT coalesce(subcategory, 'None') AS topic, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount_cents < 0 AND category = 'Dining' GROUP BY topic ORDER BY total_eur DESC

datapoints.question: How much of my 2025 spending is categorized and how much still needs review?
datapoints.why: A CASE that labels a booking by its category is allowed; the same CASE over the booking text is refused by the guard. The difference is what the rule is about.
datapoints.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN category IS NULL THEN 'Needs review' ELSE 'Categorized' END AS topic, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount_cents < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY topic ORDER BY topic

datapoints.question: Vergleiche meine Ausgaben fuer Lebensmittel und fuers Essengehen, pro Quartal.
datapoints.why: Two dimensions that really cross: four quarters times two categories is eight rows, and grouping by only one of them silently answers half the question.
datapoints.sql: SELECT '2025-Q' || ((CAST(strftime('%m', booked_on) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3) AS quarter, category AS topic, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount_cents < 0 AND category IN ('Groceries', 'Dining') AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY quarter, topic ORDER BY quarter, topic

datapoints.question: Wie viele Buchungen hatte ich pro Monat?
datapoints.why: A series of counts rather than of euros: nothing here is money, so a euro column would be an invention.
datapoints.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, COUNT(*) AS bookings FROM transaction_view GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

datapoints.question: How much did I spend at Edeak?
datapoints.why: A typo in the merchant name. The list of busiest counterparties in the prompt is what the model corrects it against, and with no period named the answer is the whole data.
datapoints.sql: SELECT ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount_cents < 0 AND (lower(description || ' ' || coalesce(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%edeka%')

datapoints.question: Und pro Woche?
prefix: Wie viel habe ich im Mai 2025 ausgegeben?
datapoints.why: The period stays and the grouping changes. May has five week buckets, so five rows.
datapoints.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%W', booked_on) AS week, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount_cents < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-05-01' AND '2025-05-31' GROUP BY week ORDER BY week

datapoints.question: Was habe ich diesen Monat bisher ausgegeben?
datapoints.why: This month is December, and 'bisher' changes nothing about the statement: the data ends where it ends.
datapoints.sql: SELECT ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount_cents < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-12-01' AND '2025-12-31'

datapoints.question: Aufschluesselung meiner Ausgaben fuer Subscriptions im Jahr 2025 nach Haendler.
datapoints.why: Groups specifically within the Subscriptions category by merchant to see distinct provider costs.
datapoints.sql: SELECT coalesce(counterparty, description) AS merchant, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount < 0 AND category = 'Subscriptions' AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY merchant ORDER BY total_eur DESC

datapoints.question: Habe ich diesen Monat oder letzten Monat mehr ausgegeben?
datapoints.why: Relative periods (this month vs last month) evaluated against the latest month in data (December 2025)
datapoints.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

datapoints.question: Habe ich im ersten oder im zweiten Quartal 2025 mehr fuer Transport ausgegeben?
datapoints.why: Period comparison for a specific category over Q1 and Q2
datapoints.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31' THEN '2025-Q1' ELSE '2025-Q2' END AS quarter, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount < 0 AND category = 'Transport' AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-06-30' GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter

datapoints.question: How did my monthly spending on dining out develop in the second quarter of 2025?
datapoints.why: Filters to Q2 (April-June) and breaks down dining spending by month.
datapoints.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount < 0 AND category = 'Dining' AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-06-30' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

datapoints.question: Welche 5 Haendler hatten 2025 den hoechsten Durchschnittsbetrag pro Buchung, bei mindestens 3 Einkaeufen?
datapoints.why: Average spending per counterparty with HAVING clause count filter.
datapoints.sql: SELECT coalesce(counterparty, description) AS merchant, ROUND(-AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY merchant HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY avg_eur DESC LIMIT 5

datapoints.question: Was waren meine 3 groessten Ausgaben im November 2025?
datapoints.why: Specific single-month window and largest single negative amounts (amount ASC).
datapoints.sql: SELECT booked_on, coalesce(counterparty, description) AS merchant, ROUND(-amount, 2) AS amount_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-30' ORDER BY amount ASC LIMIT 3

datapoints.question: Was habe ich 2025 insgesamt bei Vattenfall und Vodafone bezahlt, aufgeschluesselt nach Anbieter?
datapoints.why: Grouping two specific utilities/telecom counterparties with alias not shadowing column name
datapoints.sql: SELECT coalesce(counterparty, description) AS provider, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND (lower(description || ' ' || coalesce(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%vattenfall%' OR lower(description || ' ' || coalesce(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%vodafone%') GROUP BY provider

datapoints.question: What did I spend each month at Vapiano in Berlin Mitte during 2025, and how many visits was that?
datapoints.why: Calculates both monthly spending and monthly visit frequency for VAPIANO Berlin Mitte
datapoints.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur, COUNT(*) AS visits FROM transaction_view WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND lower(description || ' ' || coalesce(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%vapiano%' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

datapoints.question: Und im Dezember?
prefix: Wie viel habe ich im November 2025 fuer Restaurantbesuche ausgegeben?
datapoints.why: Shifts the month to December while maintaining the spending filter and Restaurant subcategory.
datapoints.sql: SELECT ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-12-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND subcategory = 'Restaurant'

datapoints.question: And on Groceries?
prefix: How much did I spend on Dining in October 2025?
datapoints.why: Inherits month period October 2025 and switches target category to Groceries.
datapoints.sql: SELECT ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-10-31' AND category = 'Groceries'

datapoints.question: What was my daily average spending in November 2025, calculated across all 30 days?
datapoints.why: Requires dividing the month spending total by the exact calendar days (30).
datapoints.sql: SELECT ROUND(-SUM(amount) / 30.0, 2) AS avg_daily_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-30'

datapoints.question: Zeig die kumulierten Ausgaben 2025 als Flaechendiagramm.
datapoints.why: The German running total. The last point is the year's total, which is the quick check that the frame is right.
datapoints.sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, -SUM(amount) AS spent FROM transaction_view WHERE amount_cents < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, ROUND(SUM(spent) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS cumulative_eur FROM monthly ORDER BY month

datapoints.question: Show what I spent on groceries per month in 2025.
datapoints.why: A narrow range over twelve months, so the euro axis has to include zero or a fifth of a difference reads as a cliff.
datapoints.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount_cents < 0 AND category = 'Groceries' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

datapoints.question: Zeig mir als Diagramm, wie viel von meinen Ausgaben 2025 kategorisiert ist und wie viel noch in Needs review liegt.
datapoints.why: Two bars out of a column that is NULL or not. Needs review is an absence, so the statement asks for `category IS NULL` and never for a category of that name.
datapoints.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN category IS NULL THEN 'Needs review' ELSE 'Kategorisiert' END AS topic, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount_cents < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY topic ORDER BY topic

datapoints.question: Give me a breakdown of my spending across categories in Q3 2025.
datapoints.why: Filters by the exact Q3 date range and groups by category coalescing NULLs, leaving chart shape open.
datapoints.sql: SELECT coalesce(category, 'Needs review') AS topic, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30' GROUP BY topic ORDER BY total_eur DESC

datapoints.question: Wie haben sich meine Ausgaben im Jahr 2025 Quartal fuer Quartal aufsummiert? Zeig mir den Verlauf.
datapoints.why: Requires aggregating by quarter and applying a running cumulative sum.
datapoints.sql: WITH quarterly AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31' THEN '2025-Q1' WHEN booked_on BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-06-30' THEN '2025-Q2' WHEN booked_on BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30' THEN '2025-Q3' WHEN booked_on BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31' THEN '2025-Q4' END AS quarter, -SUM(amount) AS spent FROM transaction_view WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY quarter ) SELECT quarter, ROUND(SUM(spent) OVER (ORDER BY quarter), 2) AS total_eur FROM quarterly ORDER BY quarter

datapoints.question: Stelle meine Transportausgaben 2025 nach Unterkategorien als Ringdiagramm dar.
datapoints.why: Aggregates transport subcategories (Public transport, Fuel, Ride hailing, Car) with negative amounts converted to positive values.
datapoints.sql: SELECT coalesce(subcategory, 'Sonstiges') AS label, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount < 0 AND category = 'Transport' AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY label ORDER BY total_eur DESC

datapoints.question: Welche Streaming- und Abo-Dienste haben mich 2025 am meisten gekostet? Zeig mir die Rangliste im Diagramm.
datapoints.why: Explicit merchant matching for subscriptions ranked by annual spending.
datapoints.sql: SELECT coalesce(title, counterparty, description) AS merchant, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND (lower(description || ' ' || coalesce(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%netflix%' OR lower(description || ' ' || coalesce(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%spotify%' OR lower(description || ' ' || coalesce(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%prime%' OR lower(description || ' ' || coalesce(counterparty, '')) LIKE '%adobe%') GROUP BY merchant ORDER BY total_eur DESC

datapoints.question: Vergleiche meine Barauszahlungen mit den Shopping-Ausgaben in den Monaten von Oktober bis Dezember 2025 als gruppierte Balken.
datapoints.why: Maps colloquial terms to category names ('Barauszahlungen' -> 'Cash') and groups by month.
datapoints.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, category AS topic, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND category IN ('Cash', 'Shopping') GROUP BY month, topic ORDER BY month, topic

datapoints.question: Stacked bar chart of my Transport spending by subcategory for each month in the first half of 2025.
datapoints.why: Extracts subcategory components over a fixed date range with proper null handling into 'Needs review'.
datapoints.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, coalesce(subcategory, 'Needs review') AS topic, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-06-30' AND category = 'Transport' GROUP BY month, topic ORDER BY month, topic

datapoints.question: Where did my income go in November 2025? Give me a visual breakdown of the flows.
datapoints.why: Captures income distribution over a single recent month with implicit sankey request
datapoints.sql: SELECT 'Income' AS source, coalesce(category, 'Needs review') AS target, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS amount_eur FROM transaction_view WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-30' GROUP BY target
